title: Natural open restriction comparison for derived residue homology
statement: For a scheme S with the supplied derived module categories [def-pc-derived-category], U an open and x in U, let R be exact derived restriction to the localized module site. Then R followed by localizedResidueHomology [def-sc-localized-residue-homology] is naturally isomorphic to derived pullback of S to the residue point U.ι(x) [def-pc-derived-pullback], degree-zero homology, global sections with GammaSpecIso scalar transport, and extension of scalars along the residue-field map kappa(U.ι(x)) -> kappa(x) of the open immersion [def-weil-residue-field]. This holds for every derived object, with no perfectness or invertibility hypothesis.

proof.text: Use the residue homology sheaf restriction comparison, before applying global sections. Whisker it by evaluation on the new residue scheme followed by GammaSpecIso scalar transport.

Whisker the field-spectrum tensor-pullback/global-sections comparison by original derived residue pullback and homology. Compose the two natural isomorphisms; associativity of functor composition identifies the result with the required functors.

proof_origin.note: Separate the homology-sheaf restriction comparison from the proved scalar-extension comparison; compose their whiskered isomorphisms.

theorem nonempty_localizedResidueHomology_restriction_iso (S : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ U : S.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings S.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    [∀ s : S, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u}
      (moduleRings (Spec (S.residueField s)).toRingedSpace))]
    (U : S.Opens) (x : U.toScheme) :
    Nonempty
      ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
          (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
          localizedResidueHomology S U x ≅
        derivedPullback (S.fromSpecResidueField (U.ι x)) ⋙
          DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{u}
              (moduleRings (Spec (S.residueField (U.ι x))).toRingedSpace)) 0 ⋙
          SheafOfModules.evaluation
            (moduleRings (Spec (S.residueField (U.ι x))).toRingedSpace) (op ⊤) ⋙
          ModuleCat.restrictScalars (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (S.residueField (U.ι x))).inv.hom ⋙
          ModuleCat.extendScalars (U.ι.residueFieldMap x).hom)
